source: manufacturers' specifications of electric two-seat golf cars (e.g. Club Car Onward, E-Z-GO RXV, Yamaha Drive2) and vehicle-dynamics measurements of utility vehicles (static stability factor, NHTSA rollover rating method); ranges, not one model

motor_power_kw.source: Club Car Onward 2 Passenger specifications (clubcar.com): 2.4 kW rated, 9.6 kW peak (XR lithium: 3.5 kW rated). Rated is continuous duty; a hill's climb is short, so a cart climbs on more than rated, up to its peak

climbs_grade_share.source: E-Z-GO owner's manual: never drive up, down or across an incline over 14 degrees (25 % grade); Evolution Electric Vehicles: standard carts manage 15-20 %, a 6.3 kW AC cart climbs 25 % fully loaded, more slowly than its top speed

static_stability_factor.source: NHTSA rollover resistance rating (static stability factor), applied to the cart ranges above
